summary.text: Hyderabad defeated their opponents by an innings and 40 runs after restricting them to 134 and 120, despite Bikramkumar Das scoring 50 off 107 balls and Sentu Sarkar making 27 off 74 balls. Aniketh Reddy took 5 for 21 and Tanay Thyagarajan claimed 6 for 52 for Hyderabad, whose own total of 294 featured 61 off 150 balls from Ruthik Yadav Mende against Sandip Sarkar's figures of 8 for 96.
